inventory_command: $names = @('VSTOwner','VSTSupervisor','VSTDispatcher','VSTRunner','VSTSigner','VSTWorker'); $services = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $names -contains $_.Name } | Select-Object Name,State); $principal = [Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]::new([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()); $runtime = Test-Path (Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'VST\runtime.json'); [pscustomobject]@{ Admin = $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator); Services = $services; Runtime = $runtime; Instruction = [bool]$env:VST_S2E_INSTRUCTION_INPUT; Manifest = [bool]$env:VST_S2E_MANIFEST_INPUT } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
reason: The current process is not elevated; all six VST SCM services, %ProgramData%\VST\runtime.json, VST_S2E_INSTRUCTION_INPUT, and VST_S2E_MANIFEST_INPUT are absent. The harness consumes provisioned inputs and does not install services, create keys, or self-elevate.
owner: Operator for elevated host provisioning; e2e-runner for the process E2E after prerequisites exist
